comments.author: @whateverfloatsyourboat-k9r
comments.text: My first husband was from Calabria and gave me a son. I was welcomed there as a queen of the North. 😊 Now, years after my son goes to see his nonna, aunts, uncles and cousins almost every year there , in Rossano on the Ionian coast. When he comes back to Belgium with his wife and my grand-daughter, they are so tanned I can’t believe. These people have very strong family values, it’s like going back in a time capsule. The sea is so clean and nature is gorgeous. For me the best time of the year to go there is April-May or  October. You can still swim in November without feeling cold.
